ns2:course.label: Aural Skills II
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 112) Continuation of aural skills training from MUS 107. Development of performance, notational, and listening skills in the areas of rhythm, melody, harmony, counterpoint, and formal aspects of musical structure; emphasizes tonal pitch structures. Concurrent registration in MUS 102 is required. Prerequisite: MUS 101 and MUS 107, or placement by examination.
